هَتِيتٌ A sound. Occurring in a trad. as signifying a sound made by wine poured out upon the ground. (L.) ＝
-A2- هَتِيتٌ and ↓ مَهْتُوتٌ A thing broken so as to be reduced to small fragments, or particles: stamped upon vehemently, so as to be broken. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
